_about: API inventory for TP-Link VIGI NVR1016H(UN) fw 1.1.3. Statically extracted from the web client (class.js + per-page .htm scripts) and cross-checked against a live login capture. Transport: POST https://<host>/stok=<token>/ds with body {method, <module>:{...}}; pre-auth calls (pre_auth:true) POST to https://<host>/ . $.query/$.queryP=>get, $.modify=>set, $.add=>add, $.del=>delete, $.action=>do, $.forward=>forward. Every string value in the JSON body is encodeURIComponent-escaped on the wire and decodeURIComponent-decoded on responses.

_conventions.channel_sections: Per-channel sections are named chn<N>_<section> (N = channel id, 1-based), e.g. chn3_main_res_1.
_conventions.response_envelope: Flat object echoing requested module(s) plus "error_code":0; batched requests may return a "result" array of per-item {error_code,...}.
